title: Water signs, gather round.
old_caption: Water signs, feeling everything is your power. But you were never meant to carry the whole ocean alone. Let the people who love you take a bucket or two.
One sleep to go. All twelve signs hold hands in a line, and it stops dead at Scorpio. Eye roll, blush, both hands. Who in your crew always needs the extra 'yes, you too'?
Two sleeps to go and the stars are totally calm. The deck went flying, a card landed on Virgo's head, Virgo offered to alphabetize them calmly. Who else has nervous butterflies?
Three sleeps to go, so the stars called mandatory warm-ups. Toe touches, jumping jacks, and Taurus asleep mid-jack because it's training for the sleeps. Who's counting down with us?

title: Split it, or I've got this?
old_caption: Leo wants to treat, Virgo itemized Leo's love language, and the gold card turned out to be a library card. Who wins this one, Leo or Virgo?

title: Phone face-up, or face-down?
old_caption: Gemini keeps the phone face-up in case it's urgent. Taurus hid theirs in the bread basket. Seventeen buzzes later, guess who was texting from across the table. Which side are you on?

title: Text first, or wait?
old_caption: Aries: text now, feelings expire. Capricorn: wait 48 hours, there's a spreadsheet. Aries already sent it twice. Capricorn's draft is from May. Which side are you on?

title: Day 1: What's my birth time?
old_caption:
Day one of the diary: a Taurus learns their birth time is a mystery, so they call the only witness. Mom and the baby book come through.
Knowing where you came from can be a sweet way to start.

title: Day 2: My first blind card.
old_caption:
Day two of the diary: a blind card with no photo, an overthinking list, and three outfit changes. Then the words win them over.
Getting to know someone before you see them can be a brave, lovely thing.

title: Day 3: We matched answers.
old_caption: Day three: same answer to the same question, and it was fresh bread. It's sweet how much a tiny shared thing can mean. Small things are big things when you're getting to know someone.
